targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  vendor as "Vendor",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as "Success Rate"
FROM intg_api_calls 
WHERE request_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY vendor
ORDER BY vendor

SELECT 
  date_trunc('hour', request_timestamp) as "time",
  vendor,
  AVG(response_time_ms) as "avg_response_time"
FROM intg_api_calls 
WHERE request_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', request_timestamp), vendor
ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: Minute Bar Records Collected by Vendor

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  date_trunc('hour', collection_timestamp) as "time",
  vendor || ' ' || symbol as "vendor_symbol",
  SUM(records_collected) as "total_records"
FROM intg_minute_bar_collection_metrics 
WHERE collection_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', collection_timestamp), vendor, symbol
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 
  vendor || ' ' || symbol as "Vendor Symbol",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE collection_success = true) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as "Success Rate"
FROM intg_minute_bar_collection_metrics 
WHERE collection_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY vendor, symbol
ORDER BY vendor, symbol

SELECT 
  status_code || ' (' || vendor || ')' as "Status Code",
  COUNT(*) as "Call Count"
FROM intg_api_calls 
WHERE request_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY status_code, vendor
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC

SELECT 
  request_timestamp as "Time",
  vendor as "Vendor",
  endpoint as "Endpoint",
  status_code as "Status",
  response_time_ms as "Response Time (ms)",
  error_message as "Error Message"
FROM intg_api_calls 
WHERE request_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '4 hours'
  AND status_code >= 400
ORDER BY request_timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT 
  'Tiingo ' || symbol as "Data Source",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(timestamp)))/60 as "Minutes Behind"
FROM intg_one_minute_live_tiingo
WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
GROUP BY symbol
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'Polygon ' || symbol as "Data Source",
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MAX(timestamp)))/60 as "Minutes Behind"
FROM intg_one_minute_live_polygon
WHERE timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
GROUP BY symbol
ORDER BY "Minutes Behind"

SELECT 
  date_trunc('hour', collection_timestamp) as "time",
  vendor || ' ' || symbol as "vendor_symbol",
  COUNT(*) as "collection_events",
  SUM(records_collected) as "total_records"
FROM intg_minute_bar_collection_metrics 
WHERE collection_timestamp >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY date_trunc('hour', collection_timestamp), vendor, symbol
ORDER BY 1,2
